post.description:

the order is returned as at GET /assembly/{order}, with the id of

post.description:
Racks the gathered pieces in a slot of the order's branch (or a
free-text place). The order becomes ready when no piece is left in
work; otherwise this fails with 409 `assembly_incomplete`, unless
`partial` is set, which makes the order partially ready. Pieces can
be ticked off here (`piece_ids`) unless the organization requires
scanning them.

whole branch. Boards reload when told to on the private channel
`plant.{branch_id}.board`.

post.description:
Prices the lines against the catalog, gives the order the branch's
next ticket number, computes the due time from the turnaround tier
and working hours, and tags every piece. Send an `Idempotency-Key`
header so that a retried request returns the same order (200)
instead of creating a second one (201).

put.description:
Only before any work has started (status `received`). Fails with 409
`order_version_conflict` when the order changed since `version`, and
`order_not_editable` once it is in process. Pieces are tagged again.

get.description:
Accepts a ticket number (T1-00042) or a piece's tag code
(T1-00042-03), typed with any digits and in any case. Returns the
order, plus the id of the piece when a tag was scanned.

Texts and details printed on receipts and tags, for anyone who can
see orders (settings themselves need settings.view).

post.description:
Marks the chosen ready pieces as given back; the order is completed
when none are left. Fails with 409 `handover_unpaid` while money is
owed (unless the user has `orders.handover_unpaid`),
`handover_not_ready` before the order is ready, and
`handover_piece_unavailable` for pieces not ready or not in it.

put.summary: Set where an order is kept

post.description:
In advance, at handover or in parts with different methods. Fails
with 409 `payment_exceeds_balance` above what is still owed, and
`shift_not_open` for cash while the branch's register is closed.
Up to what the customer has paid; the reason goes to the audit log.

Runs the same pricing as taking the order in, without saving
anything, so the counter can show the total and due time while the
order is being put together. Amounts are whole rials.

Allowed moves are listed in the order's `available_transitions`:
starting work, cancelling (needs `orders.cancel` and a reason; fails
with 409 `order_has_payments` while payments are recorded) and
sending a ready order back to the workshop. An order becomes ready
through assembly (POST /assembly/{order}/complete).
At intake, to record damage, or before and after. At most 12 per piece.

when there are no errors. Emptied cells remove the price.

received_at.description: Empty until an online order reaches the shop.

promo_code.description: The promo code the discount came from.

delivery_fee.description: Pickup and delivery, part of the total.

invoice.description: The invoice that bills this order (voided ones are not shown).

available_transitions.description: Statuses this order can be moved to with POST /orders/{id}/transitions.

OrderSource.description:
Where an order was taken. | | |---| | `counter`
Brought in to a branch. | | `online`
Placed by the customer in the portal, for pickup. |
OrderSource.title: OrderSource

OrderStatus.description: The coarse state of an order. Pickup and delivery states are used from phase 4 (online orders); counter orders start at "received".
OrderStatus.title: OrderStatus

PaymentMethod.description:
| | |---| | `cash`
Banknotes in the drawer. | | `card`
Card terminal (POS device); the trace number is the reference. | | `transfer`
Bank transfer or card-to-card; the reference identifies it. |
PaymentMethod.title: PaymentMethod

amount.description: Whole rials; at most the order's balance.

reference.description: Card trace number or transfer reference.

ticket_number.description: Present in a shift's payment list.

amount.description: Whole rials, always positive; `kind` says which way it went.

anyOf.description:
Side state: rework, on_hold, outsourced, in_transit, damaged or lost. | | |---| | `rework`
Failed quality control; goes back through the stations. | | `on_hold`
Held on purpose (waiting for the customer's approval, say). | | `outsourced`
At an outside vendor (rugs, leather, tailoring). | | `in_transit`
On its way between branches. | | `damaged`
Damaged in the shop; a claim is open. Still handed back. | | `lost`
Cannot be found; a claim is open. |

rack_location.description: Where it waits on the rack, once ready.

movement.description: On a transfer or at a vendor right now. @var array{kind: 'transfer'|'shipment', id: int, number: string, to: string}|null

PieceEvent.description: What happened to a piece, one row each in its history.
PieceEvent.title: PieceEvent

PieceFlag.description:
A side state on top of a piece's status. | | |---| | `rework`
Failed quality control; goes back through the stations. | | `on_hold`
Held on purpose (waiting for the customer's approval, say). | | `outsourced`
At an outside vendor (rugs, leather, tailoring). | | `in_transit`
On its way between branches. | | `damaged`
Damaged in the shop; a claim is open. Still handed back. | | `lost`
Cannot be found; a claim is open. |

tag_code.description: Printed as a barcode on the piece's tag.

number.description: Position of the piece within the order, from 1.

rack_slot.description: The rack slot it waits in, once ready.

PieceStatus.title: PieceStatus

zone.description: The service zone the point is in; null = no pickup or delivery there.

pickup.description: The booked pickup, for online orders.

items_by_driver.description: The driver lists the items at pickup; until then there are no lines.

received_at.description: Empty until the order reaches the shop.

can_cancel.description: The customer may still call it off (POST …/cancel).

customer_id.description: Lets the preview check customer-specific promo code rules.

quantity.description: Pieces for items counted one by one; kilograms or square metres otherwise.

pieces.description: Description of each physical piece, in tag order; may cover only some.

turnaround_tier_id.description: The default tier is used when left out.

promo_code.description: A manual discount or a promo code, not both.

value.description: Rials for "amount", percent (up to two decimals) for "percent".

company_department_id.description: For customers of a company: the department the order is charged to.

PriceUnit.description:
How an item's quantity is counted and priced. | | |---| | `piece`
Counted one by one; each unit becomes tagged pieces. | | `kg`
Weighed; quantity in kilograms (washing by weight). | | `sqm`
Measured; quantity in square metres (carpets, curtains). |
PriceUnit.title: PriceUnit

used_count.description: Orders (not cancelled) that used the code.

slots.description: Ticket numbers of the orders waiting in each slot.

amount.description: Whole rials; at most what has been paid.

is_owner.description: The owner role always holds every permission and cannot be edited.

users_count.description: Number of users holding the role.

SaveCompanyRequest.description: Creates (POST) or updates (PUT) a company and its contract.

national_id.description: 11-digit national id of the legal entity.

price_list_id.description: A price list other than the default one.

credit_limit.description: Rials; empty means the company pays like any customer (no account).

SaveCompanyRequest.title: SaveCompanyRequest

SaveCustomerRequest.description:
Creates (POST) or updates (PUT) a customer together with their
addresses. On update, the addresses sent replace the stored ones:
entries with an id are kept and changed, the rest are added, and
addresses left out are removed.

mobile.description: Iranian mobile number; "+98…", "98…", spaces and Persian digits are accepted.

alert.description: Shown as a warning whenever the customer is picked at the counter.

SaveCustomerRequest.title: SaveCustomerRequest

SaveDeliveryNoteRequest.description: Records (POST) or changes (PUT) a draft delivery note.

branch_id.description: In: the branch receiving the items and the company's customer the order is for.

expected_quantity.description: In: what the company stated. Out: not sent (the order's quantities).

counted_quantity.description: In: what was counted here. Out: what is being sent.

SaveDeliveryNoteRequest.title: SaveDeliveryNoteRequest

spent_on.description: The local day the money was spent.

from_register.description: Cash taken from the branch's open register (new expenses only).

icon.description: Icon name for the counter's touch grid.

pieces_per_unit.description: Physical pieces (and tags) one unit makes, e.g. 2 for a suit.

percent.description: New lists only: copy the default prices changed by this percent (−10 = 10% off).

SavePromoCodeRequest.description: Creates (POST) or updates (PUT) a promo code.

value.description: Rials for "amount"; percent (up to two decimals) for "percent".
